method: Read-only reconciliation of actual source extraction, V60 plan/receipts, current production manifest and native life manifest. Does not modify the workbook or infer event completion from decor availability.
interpretation: 522 is the real event count (174 × 3), not 532.
174 dossiers resolve to170 stage targets. Only four target groups have two dossiers; six source events per such target remain requirements, not duplicate deliverables.
75 V60 ambient sheets do not equal75 literal workbook events completed; substitutions and temporal conditions remain explicit.
447 event rows outside V60 are not certified by this lot. This is an evidence gap, not a claim that447 assets are certainly nonexistent.
The11 focused proposals all already have enabled backdrops. The7 missing-life proposals need21 distinct native ambient sheets plus separate conditional art where required.

v61ArtProgress.scope: Local accepted native art only; runtime composition, tests and publication have independent gates.

loreLimits: Night-time Pine Barrens original lateral forest composition; no exact comic panel fidelity claimed.
E71 after-combat guard is separate from the ambient set. Ambient-01 will be an original terrestrial insect motif, not fulfillment of E71.
E72 offscreen prey never assigned an unverified species; beacon is original mechanical set dressing, not a canonical named device.
Original Gotham roof composition based on crossover setting, not exact comic panel.
Helicopter and municipal officer are anonymous original production designs, not identified canonical model or named character.
Anonymous comic-inspired Street Judge, not named Dredd. Costume adaptation, not a verified exact crossover panel.
Airbus and abstract municipal display are original background designs; no exact canonical vehicle identity asserted.
2015 Archie vs Predator setting; no 2019 continuity mixing.
Anonymous visibly adult townspeople only, not named teenage Archie cast. Generic diner accessory and ambulance, not exact canonical designs.
NECA confirms Sinestro Corps Yautja attack Earth with power rings; exact terrace and energy geometry are original adaptations.

E108 visitors require validated continuity and are not currently identified or certified present. Ambient-02 original mundane turbine substitutes during random ambient playback; E108 literal event remains open.
Batman Dead End fan-film setting, not primary Predator cinematic continuity. Exact alley layout original.
Anonymous patrol after duel only; do not duplicate named Big Red or place hunters during active fight.
Original adjacent dais mechanism, not claimed reproduction of canonical Artifact geometry. Exact game prop requires an authenticated visual reference.

E147 named fauna existence verified by producer (Bhulag, internally nicknamed Sloth, rock worms), but species appearance 1:1 not verified; use explicit original vegetation ambient alternative, keep literal fauna event open.
